engineering-fourier-optics.title: Engineering Fourier Optics
engineering-fourier-optics.summary: Lecture notes by NK Nguyen, part of Elements of Fourier Optics: A Computational Approach (submitted to Springer). Begun from Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 lectures at Boston University and expanded with derivations, figures and Python code.
sources: BU ENG EC 562, Fourier Optics in Engineering
other_sources: BU ENG EC 522, Computational Optical Imaging by Lei Tian
engineering-fourier-optics.book: Elements of Fourier Optics: A Computational Approach
engineering-fourier-optics.about: All text and figures are my own. The draft began as my notes on Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 Fourier Optics in Engineering lectures at Boston University (Fall 2023) and has grown well beyond them, with derivations, worked examples and extensive Python code.
engineering-fourier-optics.textbook: J. W. Goodman, Introduction to Fourier Optics, 4th ed. (W. H. Freeman, 2017)

optimal-robust-control/1.title: EC 701 Notes 1: Introduction and Overview
optimal-robust-control/1.summary: Elements of an optimal control problem. Cost functionals: Bolza, Mayer and Lagrange forms. Lyapunov feedback vs. open-loop steering. Vector spaces, inner products and norms.
optimal-robust-control/1.textbook: D. Liberzon, Calculus of Variations and Optimal Control Theory: A Concise Introduction, Princeton University Press, 2012
optimal-robust-control/1.about: Elements of an optimal control problem. Cost functionals: Bolza, Mayer and Lagrange forms. Lyapunov feedback vs. open-loop steering. Vector spaces, inner products and norms.

optimal-robust-control/2.title: EC 701 Notes 2: Linearization
optimal-robust-control/2.summary: Linearization about equilibria and nominal trajectories. Jacobians and Taylor remainder. Pendulum: hanging, inverted and time-varying. Lyapunov's indirect method.
optimal-robust-control/2.textbook: D. Liberzon, Calculus of Variations and Optimal Control Theory: A Concise Introduction, Princeton University Press, 2012
optimal-robust-control/2.about: Linearization about equilibria and nominal trajectories. Jacobians and Taylor remainder. Pendulum: hanging, inverted and time-varying. Lyapunov's indirect method.

optimal-robust-control/3a.title: EC 701 Notes 3a: Linear System Preliminaries: Solving Linear Systems
optimal-robust-control/3a.summary: State transition matrix. Peano–Baker series. Matrix exponential and similarity transforms. Cayley–Hamilton theorem. Variation of constants.

optimal-robust-control/3b.title: EC 701 Notes 3b: Linear System Preliminaries: Controllability
optimal-robust-control/3b.summary: Accessibility and controllability. Adjoint operators. Controllability Gramian theorem. Observability Gramian and duality.

optimal-robust-control/3c.title: EC 701 Notes 3c: Linear System Preliminaries: LTI Systems and Optimality
optimal-robust-control/3c.summary: Kalman rank condition. Observability matrix. PBH test. Minimum-energy control vs. bang-bang.
optimal-robust-control/3c.textbook: D. Liberzon, Calculus of Variations and Optimal Control Theory: A Concise Introduction, Princeton University Press, 2012

optimal-robust-control/4a.title: EC 701 Notes 4a: Linear Quadratic Regulator: The Free End Point
